question: Which of the following forests is located in the state of Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gir forest**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gir forest** is located in the state of Gujarat.
 
• It is the only natural habitat of **Asiatic lions** in the world.
 
• The forest is part of the larger **Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary**, established in 1965.
 
• Gir forest covers a total area of approximately **1,412 square kilometers**.
 
• The region is also home to a variety of other wildlife, including leopards, antelopes, and numerous bird species.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kukrail forest** is located in Uttar Pradesh and is known for its crocodile nursery.
 
• **Molai forest** is an artificial forest located in Assam, created by Jadav Payeng.
 
• **Vandalur forest** is located in Tamil Nadu and is famous for the Arignar Anna Zoological Park.
 
• Gujarat is a state on the western coast of India with a rich cultural and historical heritage.
 
• The Gir forest is a significant conservation area and attracts numerous tourists and wildlife enthusiasts.
